catalog.sql:
WITH catalog AS (
SELECT source_system AS namespace,item_code,canonical_product_id,
coalesce(sap_item_name,product_name,canonical_name) AS description,
sales_uom_id AS catalog_sales_uom_id,inventory_uom_id AS catalog_inventory_uom_id,
active,status,sap_sell_item AS sell_item,
lower(regexp_replace(strip_accents(coalesce(sap_item_name,product_name,canonical_name)), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS search_name
FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE source_system='SAP_HANA'
), ranked AS (
SELECT *,CASE WHEN lower(item_code)=? THEN 0
WHEN contains(' ' || search_name || ' ', ' ' || ? || ' ') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS match_rank
FROM catalog WHERE contains(search_name,?) OR contains(lower(item_code),?)
) SELECT * EXCLUDE(search_name) FROM ranked ORDER BY match_rank,item_code LIMIT ?

No physical totals or approved line amounts. Empty results do not certify zero sales outside this publication.

actual.sql:
SELECT d.doc_date,'OINV' AS document_type,l.source_system,d.doc_entry,d.doc_num,
l.line_num,l.item_code,l.quantity,p.description,p.catalog_sales_uom_id
FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry
JOIN (SELECT item_code,coalesce(sap_item_name,product_name,canonical_name) AS description,
sales_uom_id AS catalog_sales_uom_id FROM read_parquet(?) WHERE source_system='SAP_HANA') p
ON p.item_code=l.item_code
WHERE l.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND l.source_table='INV1' AND d.source_table='OINV'
AND d.canceled='N' AND l.item_code IN (SELECT unnest(?)) AND d.doc_date IS NOT NULL
AND (? IS NULL OR d.doc_date>=?) AND (? IS NULL OR d.doc_date<?)
ORDER BY d.doc_date DESC,CAST(d.doc_entry AS BIGINT) DESC,CAST(l.line_num AS BIGINT) DESC,l.item_code LIMIT ?

monthly_regression.definition: SALES_VALID_GROSS=active OINV DocTotal; SALES_NET=SALES_VALID_GROSS-active ORIN DocTotal
monthly_regression.sql:
WITH invoices AS (
SELECT COUNT(*) documents,COUNT(DISTINCT doc_entry) unique_documents,COUNT(doc_total) amount_documents,
COALESCE(SUM(CAST(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))),0) amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system=? AND canceled=? AND currency=? AND doc_date>=? AND doc_date<?
), credits AS (
SELECT COUNT(*) documents,COUNT(DISTINCT doc_entry) unique_documents,COUNT(doc_total) amount_documents,
COALESCE(SUM(CAST(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))),0) amount
FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system=? AND canceled=? AND currency=? AND doc_date>=? AND doc_date<?
)
SELECT i.documents invoice_count,i.unique_documents unique_invoices,i.amount billed_amount,
c.documents credit_count,c.unique_documents unique_credits,c.amount credit_amount,
i.amount-c.amount net_amount,i.amount_documents invoice_amount_count,c.amount_documents credit_amount_count
FROM invoices i CROSS JOIN credits c
monthly_regression.limitations: DocDate; active N; BS only; DocTotal retains source taxes/discounts. Not cash collections. Historical completeness and separate tax/discount reconciliation not certified.
